verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Meilisearch serves a root llms.txt that it says is maintained to help AI assistants. Its docs pages also come as markdown (.md) files that point agents to a complete docs llms.txt index, which also lists the OpenAPI specs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these files, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
